children: HeartSciences entered into Amendment No. 8 to its Loan and Security Agreement and a No. 4 Amended and Restated Secured Promissory Note with Front Range Ventures. The amendment extends the maturity to the earlier of two business days after the closing of the proposed Fortitude Mining combination or January 29, 2027. Accrued interest through September 30, 2026 is due by that date, with all subsequent accrued interest payable at maturity. The company may prepay at least $50,000 at any time, applied first to interest, then principal.
